about: Five photo-led good news clippings. A full-bleed cover photograph carries a centred headline and small date over an ink gradient. Stories lead with large edge-to-edge photographs, then a centred headline and one short line. The close is centred. Sources and photo credits belong in the post description. Small house wordmarks and thin mint hairlines add a light branded skin.

cover.note: A real photograph fills the card. A soft ink gradient sits under the centred headline and small mono date. Supply the local photo and its credit with the render job.

example.headline: Who it happened to
example.line: One short line on why it helps

item.note: Repeat for five stories. The photograph sits in a mint-framed window at the top. The headline is two Anton lines: who it happened to in cream, then what changed in mint. The short line takes at most two lines. The house mark sits small and centred in its own footer. Supply visual photographs, never screenshots of text. Sources, dates and photo credits go in the post description, never in card fields.

close.note: The same close on every good-news carousel: that week's five story photographs in mint rings, in story order, then the fixed sentence 'If this inspires you to MAKE THE WORLD BETTER by combining your ideas + AI, follow for more' above the house mark. The words are part of the template and never change.
